name: time-picker
blurb: Smart time picker with natural language input and visual time selector.
description: Uses SmartDatetimeInput configured for time-only selection (showCalendar=false, showTimePicker=true). Accepts natural language time strings. Shows a scrollable time picker popover.
use_when: Picking times in isolation, such as meeting duration or reminder time.
avoid_when: When dates and times are both needed — use datetime-input instead.
a11y: Input is keyboard-accessible. Time picker is navigable and supports arrow keys.
